description: app.js stringifies salary for display before handing rows to sortEmployees, so the numeric branch of compareValues is never reached and salaries compare as strings ("12000" < "900"). Trips critical salary-numeric-ascending (900 is not first / 20000 not last) and critical source-not-mutated (salary descending is no longer numerically ordered). sorting.js and its unit tests are untouched so the build gate still passes.
